canonical_example.text: Volví a usar la versión vieja del programa. La nueva solamente reportó problemas.
canonical_example.translation: I came back to the old version of the software. The new one caused nothing but trouble.

canonical_example.text: Solamente un 60% de las víctimas reportaron el robo de su celular.
canonical_example.translation: Only 60% of victims reported that their cellphones were stolen.

canonical_example.text: Un vecino llamó a la policía y me reportó por ruidos molestos.
canonical_example.translation: A neighbor called the police and denounced me for disturbing noises.

canonical_example.text: Dayana se dirigió a la comisaría a reportar que su esposo abusó de ella.
canonical_example.translation: Dayana went to the police station to accuse her husband of abuse.

canonical_example.text: Tengo que aprender a reportarme y mantener la calma cuando me enfrento a una situación estresante.
canonical_example.translation: I need to learn how to control myself and keep calm in stressful situations.

canonical_example.text: Los visitantes deben reportarse en la recepción del edificio y presentar su documento de identidad.
canonical_example.translation: Visitors must report to the reception of the building and show their identification card.

synonyms.context: to give official information; often used with "de" o "a"

canonical_example.text: Cambiando de tema, ¿cómo está tu mamá?
canonical_example.translation: Changing the subject, how's your mom?

canonical_example.text: El tema principal de la conversación fue la falta de diligencia del estudiante.
canonical_example.translation: The principal topic of the conversation was the student's lack of diligence.

canonical_example.text: El tema del libro es la futilidad de la existencia humana.
canonical_example.translation: The theme of the book is the futility of human existence.

canonical_example.text: En este tema vamos a ver cómo las vacas producen la leche.
canonical_example.translation: In this lesson, we will look at how cows produce milk.

canonical_example.text: Recuerda que el tema de este verbo cambia cuando lo conjugas.
canonical_example.translation: Remember that the stem of this verb changes when you conjugate it.

canonical_example.text: El tema de ese programa es tan pegadizo.
canonical_example.translation: The theme from that show is so catchy.

canonical_example.text: Lo han pillado robando un coche.
canonical_example.translation: He has been caught stealing a car.

canonical_example.text: Nos robaron en la calle.
canonical_example.translation: We were robbed in the street.

canonical_example.text: Robaron a una niña del colegio.
canonical_example.translation: A girl was abducted from the school.

canonical_example.text: Robaron al bebé de los brazos de su madre.
canonical_example.translation: The baby was kidnapped from his mother's arms.

canonical_example.text: Tienes que robarle cartas a tu oponente.
canonical_example.translation: You have to draw cards from your opponent.

canonical_example.text: Robaron en mi apartamento la semana pasada pero no se llevaron nada.
canonical_example.translation: My apartment was broken into last week but nothing was taken.

synonyms.context: to take a vehicle by force

canonical_example.text: No entiendo esta frase.
canonical_example.translation: I don't understand this sentence.

canonical_example.text: La oración suena mejor al suprimir esta frase.
canonical_example.translation: The sentence sounds better if you remove this phrase.

canonical_example.text: Me gustan las frases cómicas que utiliza en sus artículos.
canonical_example.translation: I like the humorous expressions he uses in his articles.

canonical_example.text: Rita está celosa porque Ana gana más que ella.
canonical_example.translation: Rita is jealous because Ana earns more than her.

canonical_example.text: Timoteo es un supervisor muy celoso. Saca mucho provecho de su gente.
canonical_example.translation: Timoteo is a very zealous supervisor. He gets a lot out of his people.

canonical_example.text: Gracias a tus esfuerzos celosos, la empresa ha generado ganancias este trimestre.
canonical_example.translation: Thanks to your conscientious efforts, the company has turned a profit this quarter.

canonical_example.text: Me reemplazaron las gafas porque la primera vez había una falla en uno de los cristales.
canonical_example.translation: They replaced my glasses because the first time there was a defect in one of the lenses.

canonical_example.text: Estoy llamando porque creo que el carro que me vendieron tiene una falla con la transmisión.
canonical_example.translation: I'm calling because I think that the car I was sold has a fault with the transmission.

canonical_example.text: No podemos aprobar el envío de este jersey porque tiene una falla en la manga izquierda.
canonical_example.translation: We can't approve this sweater for shipment because it has a flaw in the left sleeve.

canonical_example.text: No había más remedio que aterrizar por la falla mecánica.
canonical_example.translation: There was nothing else to do but land because of the mechanical failure.

canonical_example.text: Hay muchos terremotos a lo largo de esta falla.
canonical_example.translation: There are a lot of earthquakes along this fault line.

canonical_example.text: Si no practicas, vas a fallar.
canonical_example.translation: If you don't practice, you're going to fail.

canonical_example.text: El motor de mi auto falló esta mañana.
canonical_example.translation: My car engine stopped working this morning.

canonical_example.text: Le di otra oportunidad y me falló otra vez.
canonical_example.translation: I gave her another chance and she failed me again.

canonical_example.text: El estudiante falló la respuesta.
canonical_example.translation: The student got the answer wrong.

canonical_example.text: Has fallido en tu decisión, y pagarás caro tu error.
canonical_example.translation: You have erred in your decision, and you will pay dearly your mistake.

canonical_example.text: ¿Podría haber sido una falla en el informe? Aquí no aparecen esos datos.
canonical_example.translation: Could there have been a mistake in the report? That information isn't showing up here.

canonical_example.text: Mi barrio me ha elegido a prender la falla la última noche de las Fallas.
canonical_example.translation: My neighborhood has selected me to light the falla on the last night of Fallas.

canonical_example.text: Vamos a las Fallas, la fiesta en Valencia en honor de San José.
canonical_example.translation: We're going to Fallas, the festival in Valencia in honor of Saint Joseph.

canonical_example.text: Sé qué te fallé, profesor. - No me fallaste, Beto; te fallaste a ti mismo.
canonical_example.translation: I know I let you down, professor. - You didn't let me down, Beto; you let yourself down.

canonical_example.text: La columna falló y el edificio se derrumbó.
canonical_example.translation: The column gave way and the building collapsed.

canonical_example.text: El juez falló en contra del demandado.
canonical_example.translation: The judge ruled against the defendant.

canonical_example.text: La bala falló el objetivo.
canonical_example.translation: The bullet missed the target.

canonical_example.text: Si seguimos perdiendo ventas, corremos el riesgo de fallir.
canonical_example.translation: If we keep losing sales, we risk going bankrupt.

canonical_example.text: Nuestra comida ha fallido. Uno de nosotros deberá bajar al pueblo a buscar algo de comer.
canonical_example.translation: Our food has run out. One of us will have to go down to the town to get something to eat.

synonyms.context: to make an error; often used with "con"
